Phase 3 validation summary
==========================

Version:
- CMake project: 0.3.1
- Public compat string: zragf/compat-0.3.1

Strict build:
- cmake .. -DZRAGF_ENABLE_STRICT=ON -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-Werror : PASS
- static library generated: libzragflib.a

CTest (build_strict):
- zragf_test_native: PASS
- zragf_test_wrappers: PASS
- zragf_test_corruption: PASS
- zragf_test_phase2: PASS
- zragf_test_external_vectors: PASS
- zragf_test_phase3_dynamic: PASS
- zragf_test_phase3_external_python: PASS

External Python/zlib checks:
- dynamic case: BTYPE=2, roundtrip PASS, in=3000, out=28
- fixed case:   BTYPE=1, roundtrip PASS, in=1024, out=281
- stored case:  BTYPE=0, roundtrip PASS, in=8192, out=8197

Notes:
- Public RFC1951 encoder now emits externally valid DYNAMIC headers.
- Public selector can choose STORED / FIXED / DYNAMIC.
- Wrapper finish path now uses a scratch buffer fallback, so small caller buffers can succeed when the actual encoded stream fits.
